title: Ortiz2023: Motor imagery during walking with a lower-limb exoskeleton
description: A BIDS-formatted re-release of an EEG database recording motor imagery of gait in 10 healthy participants walking with a fully assisted lower-limb exoskeleton on flat ground. Participants alternated kinesthetic motor imagery with relaxation and a regressive-count distractor task, cued by auditory stimuli. The data were recorded with 27 EEG and 4 EOG channels at 200 Hz and were collected as part of the DECODED sub-project of EUROBENCH.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Brain Products actiCHamp amplifier (27 EEG and 4 EOG channels, Ag/AgCl wet electrodes, 200 Hz sampling rate, left earlobe reference, right earlobe ground, 0.1 Hz high-pass and 50 Hz notch online filters). Each 9 s trial was cued by audio and was one of three conditions: relax, motor imagery of gait, or regressive counting. Participants walked with a lower-limb exoskeleton, and each session comprised 16 runs.
